# Data model reference

Structural reference for the Acta persistence model: **15 entities**, **226 columns**, **32 indexes**, **26 check constraints**, **7 foreign keys**. Names render with the default `acta` schema prefix; substitute the configured schema if different. Code families resolve into [`code-families.md`](./code-families.md). The foreign-key enforcement policy (which references are CASCADE, RESTRICT, or deliberately unenforced) is in [`sql-recipes.md`](../guide/sql-recipes.md#foreign-key-policy).

## Entity reference

### `acta.alerts` <a id="entity-acta-alerts"></a>

One materialized alert. A row carrying a non-null `DedupeKey` is an incident: the unique `(namespace_id, dedupe_key)` index, filtered to unresolved rows, admits exactly one OPEN row per key, so repeats of the same condition collapse onto it (incrementing `OccurrenceCount`) while it stays open. A null `DedupeKey` always inserts a fresh row. `ResolvedAtUtc` is the single source of truth for resolution and is terminal for the row: once stamped it is never cleared back to NULL, and the next firing of the same condition opens a new incident row on the same key.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobAlert` · **Primary key** `pk_alerts` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-alerts--id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Alert row identifier. |
| `alert_ref`<a id="column-acta-alerts--alert-ref"></a> | `Guid` | · | no | · | · | Public stable reference exposed to dashboards, HTTP APIs, and alert transports in place of the numeric id; rendered externally as "alr_" plus 26 lowercase Crockford Base32 characters. Allocated in C# (a UUIDv7 via `New`) and passed into the raising routine, never defaulted by the database. The upsert applies it on the INSERT arm only, so every repeat absorbed by an open incident keeps the ref that incident's first firing minted, and the next incident on the same key gets a ref of its own. |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-alerts--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Scope of the incident identity; at most one unresolved alert exists per `(namespace_id, dedupe_key)`. |
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-alerts--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | yes | · | · | Job that triggered the alert. No FK; SP-side validation. Operators reach the definition via `job.definition_id`. |
| `job_ref`<a id="column-acta-alerts--job-ref"></a> | `Guid` | · | yes | · | · | Public ref of the Job that triggered the alert, denormalized at write so the alert stays publicly addressable after Job purge. NULL when `JobId` is null. |
| `origin_code`<a id="column-acta-alerts--origin-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`AlertOriginCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-alertorigincode) (`alert-origin`) | Origin of the alert (`Automatic` / `Manual`); shapes the deduplication-key default and audit attribution. |
| `severity_code`<a id="column-acta-alerts--severity-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`AlertSeverityCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-alertseveritycode) (`alert-severity`) | Severity tier (`Info` / `Warning` / `Error` / `Critical`) shaping channel routing rules and oncall pages. |
| `kind_code`<a id="column-acta-alerts--kind-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`AlertKindCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-alertkindcode) (`alert-kind`) | What kind of alert this is (per the `AlertKindCode` taxonomy); informs triage flow. |
| `title`<a id="column-acta-alerts--title"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | no | · | · | Short headline for delivery channels. |
| `message`<a id="column-acta-alerts--message"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | no | · | · | Operator-readable message body; what oncall reads first. Truncated by `MessageTruncator`. |
| `channel_name`<a id="column-acta-alerts--channel-name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Channel that delivers this alert; resolved at delivery time, not at write, so there is no enforced FK. |
| `dedupe_key`<a id="column-acta-alerts--dedupe-key"></a> | `AsciiString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Operator-readable semantic grouping string (NOT a cryptographic hash). When non-null it names the incident identity: the unique `(namespace_id, dedupe_key)` index over unresolved rows collapses repeats onto the one open row; when null, every call inserts a fresh row. Sized for the Automatic-origin default template `auto:{definitionId}:{jobId}:{alert_kind}:{job_reason}` - wider than the caller-supplied `jobs.dedupe_key` (128) because Acta composes this one; the concept is the same deduplication both spell. |
| `occurrence_count`<a id="column-acta-alerts--occurrence-count"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | · | · | How many times this alert condition has fired within THIS incident - since the row opened, not over the job's life. Seeded to 1 by the alert-emitting operation on first insert (no server default); increments on every repeat the open row absorbs, and never decreases. The next incident on the same key starts a new row back at 1. |
| `last_projected_event_id`<a id="column-acta-alerts--last-projected-event-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | yes | · | · | High-water mark of the `events` row that last moved this alert automatically: the id of the failure event that last raised it, or of the success event that last resolved it. NULL means no projected event has touched the row yet (a manual alert, or an automatic one whose first projection is still in flight), and sorts before every event id. The `sys.alerts` projector commits each event's alert write before it advances its cursor, so a crash mid-batch replays events already projected; every automatic transition is conditional on the incoming event id being strictly greater than this mark, which makes that replay a no-op instead of an inflated `OccurrenceCount`. The mark also survives resolution, so a failure event replayed after the incident closed cannot open a ghost incident behind the events that already landed. Manual raises and the operator resolve verb carry no event and leave this untouched. |
| `resolved_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-alerts--resolved-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | When the underlying condition cleared (recovery instant). NULL means the alert is still unresolved and is the single source of truth for resolution. Set when a previously-failed Job's next execution succeeds, or by the operator resolve verb. Terminal for the row: no raise ever clears it back to NULL - the next failure on the same `DedupeKey` opens a new incident row instead, which is also what frees the filtered unique index for that key again. |
| `acknowledged_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-alerts--acknowledged-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | When an operator acknowledged the alert; NULL = unacknowledged. Orthogonal to `ResolvedAtUtc` (resolution = condition cleared; acknowledgement = operator has seen it). Who acknowledged is recorded on the events timeline, not here. |
| `delivery_status_code`<a id="column-acta-alerts--delivery-status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`AlertDeliveryStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-alertdeliverystatuscode) (`alert-delivery-status`) | Where the alert is in the delivery pipeline (`Pending` / `Suppressed` / `Delivered` / `Failed` / `RetryAfter`). |
| `retry_count`<a id="column-acta-alerts--retry-count"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | · | Attempts spent in the current send series, which is the delivery retry budget and not a lifetime count: a delivered send ends its series and resets this to 0, so a reminder that re-notifies a still-open incident starts with the whole retry curve rather than whatever the last series happened to spend. A row sitting at the cap in `Failed` is a series that ran out. |
| `retry_after_utc`<a id="column-acta-alerts--retry-after-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | Earliest instant this row may be sent again, whether that send is a retry or a reminder. While delivery is unsettled it is the backoff instant of the next retry. On a settled unresolved row it is the reminder schedule the settling send wrote - one `AlertReminderInterval` out - which is how an incident that stays open keeps re-notifying. Deliberately not derived from `ModifiedAtUtc`: every repeat the open incident absorbs re-stamps that column, so a job failing faster than the interval would be permanently too young to remind. Null means nothing is scheduled: a manual alert that delivered (its caller owns the lifecycle), a suppressed row, or any resolved row, since both resolve paths clear it. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-alerts--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the alert row was first created (also serves as the first-seen instant). |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-alerts--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the alert row was last updated. Set server-side on every mutation. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-alerts--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token; SPs manually increment via `SET version = version + 1` on every UPDATE. |

**Indexes**

| Name | Columns | Uniqueness | Filter | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ix_alerts_dedupe_identity` | `namespace_id`, `dedupe_key` | not unique | `dedupe_key IS NOT NULL` | `alert_raise` |
| `ix_alerts_delivery_due` | `namespace_id`, `delivery_status_code`, `retry_after_utc`, `id` | not unique | none | `maintenance` |
| `ix_alerts_namespace_created` | `namespace_id`, `created_at_utc` DESC, `id` DESC | not unique | none | `dashboard_grid` |
| `ix_alerts_namespace_unresolved` | `namespace_id`, `created_at_utc` DESC, `id` DESC | not unique | `resolved_at_utc IS NULL` | `dashboard_grid` |
| `ux_alerts_ref` | `alert_ref` | unique | none | `uniqueness` |
| `ux_alerts_dedupe` | `namespace_id`, `dedupe_key` | unique | `dedupe_key IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at_utc IS NULL` | `uniqueness` |

**Check constraints**

| Name | SQL expression |
|---|---|
| `ck_alerts_job_ref_pair` | `(job_id IS NULL AND job_ref IS NULL) OR (job_id IS NOT NULL AND job_ref IS NOT NULL)` |
| `ck_alerts_occurrence_count` | `occurrence_count >= 1` |

### `acta.checkpoints` <a id="entity-acta-checkpoints"></a>

One durable substrate slot per `(JobId, Kind, Name)` in the merged `checkpoints` table: user variables, signals, sleep timers, the progress slot, and child terminal-outcome latches all share this one physical shape, discriminated by `Kind`. Steps are richer (attempt counters, retry budget) and stay in the separate `steps` table.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobCheckpoint` · **Primary key** `pk_checkpoints` (`job_id`, `kind_code`, `name`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | · | PK | Owning Job. CASCADE FK: when the Job is purged, every checkpoint row for it cascades away in the same transaction. Leading column of the composite PK. |
| `kind_code`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--kind-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobCheckpointKindCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobcheckpointkindcode) (`job-checkpoint-kind`) | Which substrate feature owns this slot (variable / signal / timer / progress / child-latch). Part of the composite PK, so identical names under different kinds never collide. |
| `name`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | PK | Slot name. Dotted-kebab ASCII for user variables and signals; `sys.progress` for the progress slot; `sys.child.{childId}` for child latches. The `sys.` prefix stays system-reserved for user-writable kinds. Part of the composite PK. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | yes | · | [`JobCheckpointStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobcheckpointstatuscode) (`job-checkpoint-status`) | `Pending` / `Set` / `Expired` (signals, child latches) or `Pending` / `Consumed` (timers). NULL for the stateless kinds (variable, progress). |
| `due_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--due-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | The named wait's absolute expiration: a timer's due instant, or a bounded signal / child wait's deadline (NULL on an unbounded wait and on every stateless kind). Written once when the slot is armed and never extended, so a replay reuses it. Distinct from the Job's `next_run_at_utc`, which is the job-level claimability cache derived from it on suspend. |
| `value_format_id`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--value-format-id"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | `0` | [`JobPayloadFormat`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobpayloadformat) | Format-id selector for `Value`. `0` means no payload (pending signal, timer, presence-only raise), and is the server default so payload-free kinds omit the pair; `ck_checkpoints_value_pair` enforces `(value_format_id = 0) = (value IS NULL)`. |
| `value`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--value"></a> | `BinaryPayload` | max | yes | · | · | Encoded slot payload; opaque bytes governed by `ValueFormatId`. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | First-write instant. Rendered server-side via `UtcNow` on INSERT. |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | Last write of any kind (state transition, value overwrite); operations bump on every UPDATE. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-checkpoints--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token; operations manually increment via `SET version = version + 1` on every UPDATE. |

**Check constraints**

| Name | SQL expression |
|---|---|
| `ck_checkpoints_value_pair` | `(value_format_id = 0 AND value IS NULL) OR (value_format_id <> 0 AND value IS NOT NULL)` |

**Foreign keys**

| Constraint | Column → Target | On delete |
|---|---|---|
| `fk_checkpoints_jobs` | `job_id` → `acta.jobs(id)` | CASCADE |

### `acta.definitions` <a id="entity-acta-definitions"></a>

The live job policy: one row per definition, the single source of truth for every per-job policy. Each policy field is a default (code-owned, synced from `[Job]`) paired with a nullable override (operator-edited, NULL = none); the effective value is `COALESCE(<field>_override, <field>)`, computed at the point of use and never stored. Identity, the type contract, and formats are code-fixed (no override). One entity, never split.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobDefinition` · **Primary key** `pk_definitions` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-definitions--id"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Surrogate PK referenced by `Job.DefinitionId`, `JobEvent.DefinitionId`, and `JobSchedule.DefinitionId`. |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-definitions--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Owning service's namespace; logical FK to `JobNamespace.Id` (no enforced FK, SP-side validation). |
| `name`<a id="column-acta-definitions--name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Operator-facing kebab-case identifier; the natural key together with the namespace. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-definitions--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobDefinitionStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobdefinitionstatuscode) (`job-definition-status`) | Lifecycle of this definition (`Active` / `Retired`), code/sync-owned; enqueue is rejected at the DB boundary by `enqueue_batch` when not `Active`. No override. |
| `definition_hash`<a id="column-acta-definitions--definition-hash"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | SHA-256 hex over all code-owned columns (policy defaults + contract + formats), computed C#-side at registration. Drives the write short-circuit: the C# gate compares this against the stored value and only sends rows whose hash differs (or that are new / not Active) into the upsert. Operator override columns are NOT part of this hash, so overrides survive re-sync. Identity-adjacent control field: which code-version wrote this row. |
| `manifest_generation_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-definitions--manifest-generation-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | · | · | Manifest generation (build timestamp) of the worker that last wrote this row. The monotonic governor: a registration may update the row only when its incoming generation is greater than or equal to this value, so an older deployment cannot roll policy back. |
| `input_type_name`<a id="column-acta-definitions--input-type-name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 512 | no | · | · | CLR full type name of the `[Job]` handler's input contract; the type-driven dispatch key for `IJobs.EnqueueAsync<TIn>`. |
| `input_format_id`<a id="column-acta-definitions--input-format-id"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPayloadFormat`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobpayloadformat) | Default payload format id for input payloads enqueued against this definition; stamped into `Job.InputFormatId` at enqueue. |
| `input_format_name`<a id="column-acta-definitions--input-format-name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Default input payload format name, from the handler's `[Job(Format = "...")]` or `[Job(InputFormat = "...")]` declaration; resolved against registered serializers at startup. |
| `output_type_name`<a id="column-acta-definitions--output-type-name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 512 | yes | · | · | CLR full type name of the handler's output contract; null for void handlers. |
| `output_format_id`<a id="column-acta-definitions--output-format-id"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPayloadFormat`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobpayloadformat) | Default payload format id for execution results; stamped into `JobResult.ResultFormatId` on terminal success. |
| `output_format_name`<a id="column-acta-definitions--output-format-name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Default payload format name for execution results; mirrors `InputFormatName`. |
| `tenant_requirement_code`<a id="column-acta-definitions--tenant-requirement-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobTenantRequirementCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobtenantrequirementcode) (`job-tenant-requirement`) | Whether jobs of this definition must, may, or must not carry a tenant; enforced by the enqueue routines. Code-fixed like the type contract (no operator override triple): the requirement is contract-adjacent, and an operator flip would break handler assumptions about tenant scope. |
| `priority_code`<a id="column-acta-definitions--priority-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPriorityCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobprioritycode) (`job-priority`) | Default priority for Jobs enqueued from this definition; per-instance overrides apply at enqueue and post-enqueue. |
| `priority_code_override`<a id="column-acta-definitions--priority-code-override"></a> | `Byte` | · | yes | · | [`JobPriorityCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobprioritycode) (`job-priority`) | Operator override of `Priority`; NULL = inherit the default. |
| `priority_code_effective`<a id="column-acta-definitions--priority-code-effective"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPriorityCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobprioritycode) (`job-priority`) | Effective priority (DB-computed); read-only. |
| `max_attempts`<a id="column-acta-definitions--max-attempts"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Cap on consecutive failures before terminal `Status = Failed` for one-off jobs; resets on success. Recurring slots never terminalize on the count (MaxAttempts is the one-off budget only). |
| `max_attempts_override`<a id="column-acta-definitions--max-attempts-override"></a> | `Int16` | · | yes | · | · | Operator override of `MaxAttempts`; NULL = inherit the default. |
| `max_attempts_effective`<a id="column-acta-definitions--max-attempts-effective"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Effective max-attempts (DB-computed); read-only. |
| `backoff`<a id="column-acta-definitions--backoff"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 64 | no | · | · | Retry backoff policy as an Acta backoff expression, e.g. `"1m..8h x2 ~10%"`. Resolved to a concrete expression at registration (framework default `"1m..1d x2 ~10%"` when the attribute sets none); parsed by workers, never by SQL. |
| `backoff_override`<a id="column-acta-definitions--backoff-override"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 64 | yes | · | · | Operator override of `Backoff`; NULL = inherit. Validated as a parseable expression at write. |
| `backoff_effective`<a id="column-acta-definitions--backoff-effective"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 64 | no | · | · | Effective backoff expression (DB-computed); read-only. |
| `execution_timeout_seconds`<a id="column-acta-definitions--execution-timeout-seconds"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | · | · | Per-attempt wall-clock cap; cancels the handler's `CancellationToken` when exceeded. Does not span retries. Capped so a duration always fits `JobEvent.DurationMs`. |
| `execution_timeout_seconds_override`<a id="column-acta-definitions--execution-timeout-seconds-override"></a> | `Int32` | · | yes | · | · | Operator override of `ExecutionTimeoutSeconds`; NULL = inherit. |

### `acta.events` <a id="entity-acta-events"></a>

Append-only lifecycle timeline and execution ledger. Carries the audit trail of `JobRuntime.Status` transitions, suspend/resume hops, signal arrivals, and definition/worker lifecycle events, plus the canonical per-attempt record via paired `job.execution-started` / `job.execution-finished` events. Carries lifecycle facts and outcomes, plus an optional `Detail` payload for free-form (text) or structured (json) context beyond `ReasonCode` / `ReasonMessage`; richer event-specific data still belongs in OTel spans and structured logs at the emission site, and the canonical durable state is the entity row the event references.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobEvent` · **Primary key** `pk_events` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-events--id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Event row identifier. |
| `event_code`<a id="column-acta-events--event-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`EventCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-eventcode) (`event`) | What happened; the numeric id decodes via the `event` family in docs/98, e.g. `41 = "job.execution-finished"`. Closed taxonomy. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-events--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the event was committed; rendered server-side via `UtcNow` in the same transaction as the state mutation. The operation does not supply this value from C#. Named `created_at_utc` for parity with every other entity's row-creation timestamp; for events, the row-creation instant IS the event-occurrence instant (events are insert-only). |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-events--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Namespace this event belongs to; per-namespace timeline queries seek without joining. |
| `actor_code`<a id="column-acta-events--actor-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`ActorCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-actorcode) (`actor`) | Who caused the transition (`Sys` / `Worker` / `Operator` / `Job`). System-determined at the emission site; callers cannot pass it directly. |
| `actor_key`<a id="column-acta-events--actor-key"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Identifier of the actor whose `ActorCode` classifies it. Format depends on `ActorCode`; see the `ActorCode` doc. A string identifier by design (its format varies by `ActorCode`), an accepted exception to the integer-`_id` convention. |
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-events--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | yes | · | · | Owning Job (logical reference; no DB constraint, events outlive Job retention). Set for job-scoped events, null for definition / worker events. It stays the stable timeline key after a Job row is purged: identity ids are never reused, so `job_id` remains a unique address even once the row it referenced is gone. |
| `job_ref`<a id="column-acta-events--job-ref"></a> | `Guid` | · | yes | · | · | Public ref of the owning Job, denormalized at emission so the PUBLIC identity survives Job purge: `JobId` stays the internal address, this stays the public one operators and clients hold. NULL on definition / worker events, mirroring `JobId`. |

Set on `job.execution.*`, `job.step.*`, and other per-attempt events; NULL for definition, worker, and Job-level transitions without an attempt context. |
| `lineage_root_id`<a id="column-acta-events--lineage-root-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | yes | · | · | Root of the lineage tree this event belongs to; powers whole-lineage timeline queries via `ix_events_lineage_timeline`. Null for definition / worker events. |
| `definition_id`<a id="column-acta-events--definition-id"></a> | `Int32` | · | yes | · | · | Surrogate key into `JobDefinition`. Set on every job-scoped event; supports analytics that group by Job type without joining `Job` (which is retention-deletable). Null on worker-lifecycle events. |

The failure budget on `JobRuntime.FailureCount` charges only on `Failed` / `Orphaned`. |

Operators JOIN the `job-event-reason` family in docs/98 for the kebab string. |

### `acta.jobs` <a id="entity-acta-jobs"></a>

One row in `acta.jobs`, Acta's only work unit: the append-mostly identity/input record. Hot mutable state (status, next run, counters, retention) lives on the 1:1 `runtimes` row, which also carries execution ownership/TTL (`leases` holds named locks only); result history lives in `results`, keyed by the composite `(job_id, execution_number)` clustered PK. Recurring Jobs are a single reusable row whose runtime `next_run_at_utc` rolls forward on terminal completion (no per-firing row inflation).

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.Job` · **Primary key** `pk_jobs` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-jobs--id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Primary key and internal engine identity, used by every join, claim, event, and lock; the public handle is `JobRef`. Provider-native IDENTITY: the database assigns the id at INSERT, and `enqueue_batch` correlates the `RETURNING`/`OUTPUT` rows back to their input via the caller-supplied `JobRef` (insertion order is not guaranteed). |
| `job_ref`<a id="column-acta-jobs--job-ref"></a> | `Guid` | · | no | · | · | Public stable reference exposed to dashboards, HTTP APIs, and clients in place of the numeric id; rendered externally as "job_" plus 26 lowercase Crockford Base32 characters. Allocated in C# (a UUIDv7 via `New`) and passed into the inserting routine, never defaulted by the database. Source of truth here and denormalized onto the audit tables (events, alerts) so the public ref survives Job purge; CASCADE child/substrate tables keep numeric ids only. Never used for internal joins, claim ordering, or keyset pagination. |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-jobs--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Service-owned execution boundary and the hot-path claim filter. FK semantics enforced by SP, not DB. |
| `definition_id`<a id="column-acta-jobs--definition-id"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | · | · | Surrogate key into `definitions`; keeps the hot row narrow. |
| `lineage_root_id`<a id="column-acta-jobs--lineage-root-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | yes | · | · | Identifies the lineage tree this Job belongs to. `NULL` for root jobs (the root is its own `Id`); children carry `parent.LineageRootId`. Set at INSERT, never mutated. Event-emitting routines resolve the effective root as `COALESCE(lineage_root_id, id)` so a root's own events still land on the `events` lineage timeline index. |
| `parent_id`<a id="column-acta-jobs--parent-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | yes | · | · | Causal parent for child jobs; null for root jobs. No FK; SP write-time validation. |
| `tenant_id`<a id="column-acta-jobs--tenant-id"></a> | `Int32` | · | yes | · | · | Optional customer / business entity this Job is about, resolved from the enqueue `TenantKey` against the `tenants` catalog. NULL when the enqueue supplied no tenant (and for system Jobs). Immutable after enqueue; child Jobs inherit the parent's tenant unless they supply their own. Audit / query / runtime scope only, never a claim or scheduling scope. |
| `deduplication_key`<a id="column-acta-jobs--deduplication-key"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Deduplication key on enqueue and operator-facing stable address for `IJobs.GetJobIdAsync`. User keys cannot start with `"sys."` (system-reserved prefix). Uniqueness scope differs by row kind: root jobs are unique per `JobNamespace` (`ux_jobs_deduplication_key_root`, filtered to `parent_id IS NULL`); child jobs are unique per direct parent (`ux_jobs_deduplication_key_child`, filtered to `parent_id IS NOT NULL`), so siblings need distinct keys but a key may recur in a different subtree. |
| `correlation_key`<a id="column-acta-jobs--correlation-key"></a> | `AsciiString` | 64 | yes | · | · | Opaque correlation key threading related jobs across systems: a W3C trace id or a caller's own custom value. At most 64 chars; null = uncorrelated. |
| `exclusive_key`<a id="column-acta-jobs--exclusive-key"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Named mutual-exclusion key. Semaphore size permanently 1. Kebab-case. Enforced by an execution-time lock (`{ns_id}.excl.{key}` lease row) the runner takes after claim; a claimed loser re-arms Ready after the fixed bounce delay. |
| `input_format_id`<a id="column-acta-jobs--input-format-id"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPayloadFormat`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobpayloadformat) | Format-id selector for this row's input. `0` means no input (`JobPayloadFormat.None`); the `ck_jobs_input_pair` CHECK enforces that `input_format_id = 0` holds exactly when `input IS NULL`. |
| `input`<a id="column-acta-jobs--input"></a> | `BinaryPayload` | max | yes | · | · | Encoded input payload. NULL when `InputFormatId` is `0` (no input); non-NULL otherwise (may be an empty byte sequence for legitimately empty `text`/`bytes` payloads). Format governed by `InputFormatId`. |
| `audit_level_code`<a id="column-acta-jobs--audit-level-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobAuditLevelCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobauditlevelcode) (`job-audit-level`) | Per-job snapshot of the definition's audit level, copied from `definitions` at enqueue. Gates audit-filtered per-job `JobEvent` emission on the hot path (claim / start / complete / control) without a join: `Off` suppresses them, `Failures` emits only failed `job.execution-finished`, `Audit` emits all. Always-on system / catalog events ignore this column. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-jobs--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the Job was enqueued. Set server-side. |

### `acta.locks` <a id="entity-acta-locks"></a>

One row per held named lock in the `locks` table: the rows behind both the handler-facing `JobContext.RunWithLockAsync` and the `exclusive_key` execution mutex the runner takes after claim. Execution ownership/TTL is not a row here - it lives on the `runtimes` row. Lifecycle is `ExpiresAtUtc` alone (no status column): held while ahead of now. Acquire is a steal-on-expiry upsert; release DELETEs the row - exclusive keys are unbounded per-job user strings, so the table stays O(currently held) by construction (`ReleaseLockSpec` pins that); abandoned rows are swept by the `sys.retention` reap. `HoldToken` is minted fresh per hold and CAS-guards extend and release: unlike a counter, no other hold can ever re-mint it, so a stale holder that slept through a full steal-release-reacquire cycle still cannot free or extend its successor's lock. `LockKey` is an opaque discriminator-segmented composite (`{namespace_id}.lock.{key}`, `global.lock.{key}`, `{namespace_id}.excl.{key}`) so the lock spaces never collide on identical user text; keying on namespace id keeps the key compact and stable across renames.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.Lock` · **Primary key** `pk_locks` (`lock_key`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lock_key`<a id="column-acta-locks--lock-key"></a> | `AsciiString` | 256 | no | · | PK | Opaque composite lock identity and primary key. Holds a discriminator-segmented string (`{ns}.lock.{key}` / `global.lock.{key}` / `{ns}.excl.{key}`); never parsed for safety, since keys are compared as whole strings. |
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-locks--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | · | · | Job that currently holds (or last held) the lock. No FK; written by the acquire routine for observability ("which job holds this lock"). Release is token-CAS on the PK, not on this column. |
| `expires_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-locks--expires-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | · | · | Instant the current hold expires. Held while ahead of now; free once at or before now (stealable in place via steal-on-expiry). Release deletes the row rather than expiring it. |
| `hold_token`<a id="column-acta-locks--hold-token"></a> | `Guid` | · | no | · | · | Per-hold CAS token, minted by the caller on every acquire (fresh insert and steal alike). Extend and release guard on it, so only the current holder can do either. |

**Indexes**

| Name | Columns | Uniqueness | Filter | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ix_locks_reclaim_expired` | `expires_at_utc` | not unique | none | `lock_reclaim` |

### `acta.namespaces` <a id="entity-acta-namespaces"></a>

Service-owned execution boundary. One deployable service owns one `JobNamespace`; replicas of that service share it (on a catalog-hash match the upsert is a no-op). Cross-service collisions fail at startup with `JobNamespaceConflictException`.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobNamespace` · **Primary key** `pk_namespaces` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | DB-assigned identity (`IDENTITY(1,1)` on SQL Server, `GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` on Postgres). Referenced by every hot table via `namespace_id`. Callers never pick the value; the worker runtime upserts the row by `Name` via the `StartWorker` handler (which registers the namespace and the worker in one round trip) and reads the assigned id back. |
| `name`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Operator-readable namespace name. Unique. Kebab-case. |
| `owner_team`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--owner-team"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Owning team identifier surfaced on operator dashboards. Unicode-capable. |
| `description`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--description"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Operator-readable description of what this namespace owns. Unicode-capable. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`NamespaceStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-namespacestatuscode) (`namespace-status`) | Namespace lifecycle status. Supplied at INSERT by the StartWorker registration (no server-side default), mirroring the tenant convention. Enforced at enqueue: EnqueueOne/EnqueueBatch reject with a distinguishable error when the resolved namespace is not Active. |
| `catalog_hash`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--catalog-hash"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | yes | · | · | SHA-256 hex of the canonicalized assembly catalog. NULL means the namespace row was created before any catalog hash was computed (pre-registration; the hash is unwritten). |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the namespace row was first created. Set server-side. |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the namespace row was last updated. Set server-side on every mutation. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-namespaces--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token; SPs manually increment on UPDATE. |

**Indexes**

| Name | Columns | Uniqueness | Filter | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ux_namespaces_name` | `name` | unique | none | `uniqueness` |

### `acta.results` <a id="entity-acta-results"></a>

Cold payload table: one row per Job attempt that produced a durable result, keyed by the composite `(JobId, ExecutionNumber)`. Result bytes never live on the hot `Job` row, and recurring Jobs accumulate one cold row per terminal firing instead of overwriting a single hot LOB slot. The latest retained result for a Job is a single-row seek against the clustered PK (`WHERE JobId = @id ORDER BY ExecutionNumber DESC`).

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobResult` · **Primary key** `pk_results` (`job_id`, `execution_number`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-results--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | · | PK | Owning Job. Part of the composite clustered PK with `ExecutionNumber`; the FK cascades from `acta.jobs` so a Job retention-delete sweeps every result row for it. bigint. |
| `execution_number`<a id="column-acta-results--execution-number"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | · | PK | Which attempt produced this result. Part of the composite clustered PK; together with `JobId` uniquely identifies the result row across the Job's history of attempts. The value matches the `JobEvent.ExecutionNumber` on the corresponding `job.execution-finished` event. int. |
| `result_format_id`<a id="column-acta-results--result-format-id"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPayloadFormat`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobpayloadformat) | Format-id selector for `Result`. The source of truth for the result's payload format. tinyint. |
| `result`<a id="column-acta-results--result"></a> | `BinaryPayload` | max | no | · | · | Encoded result payload; opaque bytes whose format is governed by `ResultFormatId`. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-results--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the row was inserted; rendered server-side via `UtcNow` in the same transaction as the `job.execution-finished` event. The operation does not supply this value from C#. |

**Check constraints**

| Name | SQL expression |
|---|---|
| `ck_results_format_not_none` | `result_format_id <> 0` |

**Foreign keys**

| Constraint | Column → Target | On delete |
|---|---|---|
| `fk_results_jobs` | `job_id` → `acta.jobs(id)` | CASCADE |

### `acta.runtimes` <a id="entity-acta-runtimes"></a>

The hot mutable runtime state of one Job: one row in `runtimes` per `jobs` row, split out so claim/complete churn never rewrites the append-mostly identity/input row. Every job state transition (claim, start, complete, control verb, schedule firing) updates this row and bumps `Version`, the CAS token for job state transitions. Execution ownership/TTL lives here too (`LeasedByWorkerId` / `LeaseExpiresAtUtc`): a claim is one UPDATE of this row, and the heartbeat pushes `LeaseExpiresAtUtc` without bumping `Version`. The `leases` table carries named locks only.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobRuntime` · **Primary key** `pk_runtimes` (`job_id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | · | PK | Owning Job; primary key (1:1 with `jobs`) and CASCADE FK, so a purged job sweeps its runtime row in the same transaction. Supplied by enqueue, never DB-assigned. |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Immutable copy of the owning Job's namespace, denormalized so the hot claim, reclaim, and retention scans filter and seek without joining `jobs` (`ix_runtimes_claim_ready` / `ix_runtimes_retention` lead with it). Written once at insert, never updated. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobstatuscode) (`job-status`) | Durable lifecycle of the Job (Paused / Suspended / Ready / Dispatched / Executing / Succeeded / Failed / Cancelled). |
| `priority_code`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--priority-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPriorityCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobprioritycode) (`job-priority`) | Claim-order key set from the definition policy, definition override, or per-enqueue override. |
| `next_run_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--next-run-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | Next claim instant; the hot-path claim filter compares against this. On a `Suspended` row it carries the awaited slot's expiration, or NULL for an unbounded wait, which is what keeps an unbounded wait unclaimable while a bounded one wakes at its deadline. |
| `execution_number`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--execution-number"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | · | · | Monotonic-lifetime claim counter; incremented atomically on each claim. |
| `failure_count`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--failure-count"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Current-cycle failure counter; compared against `MaxAttempts`. |
| `leased_by_worker_id`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--leased-by-worker-id"></a> | `Int32` | · | yes | · | · | Worker that currently holds the in-flight execution lease, if any. No FK; write-time validation in the claim routine. Paired with `LeaseExpiresAtUtc` by `ck_runtimes_lease_consistency`. |
| `lease_expires_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--lease-expires-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | Execution lease expiry instant; the heartbeat pushes it forward without bumping `Version`, and `sys.recovery` reclaims in-flight rows past it. |
| `retention_until_utc`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--retention-until-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | When `sys.retention` deletes the owning job row (this row cascades with it). |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the runtime row was last updated. Set server-side on every mutation. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-runtimes--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token for job state transitions; operations manually increment via `SET version = version + 1` on every UPDATE. Heartbeats never bump it: a lease TTL refresh is not a claim-generation change, so a buffered claim still passes the start CAS. |

**Indexes**

| Name | Columns | Uniqueness | Filter | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ix_runtimes_claim_ready` | `namespace_id`, `priority_code` DESC, `next_run_at_utc`, `job_id` | not unique | `status_code IN (10, 20)` | `claim_hot_path` |
| `ix_runtimes_retention` | `namespace_id`, `retention_until_utc`, `job_id` | not unique | `retention_until_utc IS NOT NULL AND status_code IN (100, 200, 220)` | `maintenance` |
| `ix_runtimes_worker_inflight` | `leased_by_worker_id`, `status_code` | not unique | `leased_by_worker_id IS NOT NULL AND status_code IN (40, 50)` | `heartbeat` |

**Check constraints**

| Name | SQL expression |
|---|---|
| `ck_runtimes_lease_consistency` | `(leased_by_worker_id IS NULL AND lease_expires_at_utc IS NULL) OR (leased_by_worker_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at_utc IS NOT NULL)` |
| `ck_runtimes_counters` | `execution_number >= 0 AND failure_count >= 0` |

**Foreign keys**

| Constraint | Column → Target | On delete |
|---|---|---|
| `fk_runtimes_jobs` | `job_id` → `acta.jobs(id)` | CASCADE |

### `acta.schedules` <a id="entity-acta-schedules"></a>

One named recurring schedule attached to a definition's slot Job. The `Origin` records how the row came to exist. Sparse override model (mirrors JobDefinition): the bare field carries the origin-of-truth default and its `*_override` carries the operator edit (NULL = inherit); effective = `COALESCE(_override, default)`. Only `expression` and `time_zone_id` are operator-overridable. The canonical per-schedule cursor is `NextRunAtUtc`; the slot Job's cursor is the MIN over its live schedules.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobSchedule` · **Primary key** `pk_schedules` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-schedules--id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Schedule row identifier. |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-schedules--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Per-namespace reload tick filters by this. |
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-schedules--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | · | · | Structural identity for the recurring Job row this schedule fires. The recurring Job row owns its schedules; purge cascades to all schedule rows. |
| `definition_id`<a id="column-acta-schedules--definition-id"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | · | · | Denormalized from `Job.DefinitionId` at INSERT; never mutated. Safe because `Job.DefinitionId` is `init` (immutable post-INSERT). Retained for the per-namespace reload sweep and the catalog-upsert "find Definition-origin slot for this (ns, def)" lookup without joining `jobs`. |
| `name`<a id="column-acta-schedules--name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Operator-readable schedule name. For Definition-origin it matches the `[JobSchedule(name)]` attribute parameter. Kebab-case ASCII. The `sys.` prefix is reserved for system-owned schedule names, for parity with the other Name columns. |
| `origin_code`<a id="column-acta-schedules--origin-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`ScheduleOriginCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-scheduleorigincode) (`schedule-origin`) | Origin of the row's existence: `Definition` (declared in a `[JobSchedule]` attribute, refreshed by catalog upsert) or `Operator`. Override columns apply to any origin. |
| `expression`<a id="column-acta-schedules--expression"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Cron or interval duration, human ("5m") or ISO 8601 ("PT5M") (the origin-of-truth default). |
| `expression_override`<a id="column-acta-schedules--expression-override"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Operator-overridden cron or interval expression, human ("5m") or ISO 8601 ("PT5M"). NULL = no override. |
| `expression_effective`<a id="column-acta-schedules--expression-effective"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Effective expression (DB-computed); read-only. |
| `time_zone_id`<a id="column-acta-schedules--time-zone-id"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | IANA tz id (the origin-of-truth default). "tz id" is the IANA standard term, a string-identifier exception to the integer-`_id` convention. |
| `time_zone_id_override`<a id="column-acta-schedules--time-zone-id-override"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Operator-overridden IANA tz id. NULL = no override. |
| `time_zone_id_effective`<a id="column-acta-schedules--time-zone-id-effective"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Effective IANA tz id (DB-computed); read-only. |
| `expression_kind_code`<a id="column-acta-schedules--expression-kind-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`ScheduleExpressionKindCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-scheduleexpressionkindcode) (`schedule-expression-kind`) | Whether `Expression` is a cron expression or an ISO 8601 interval. Set at compile time by the source generator and refreshed by catalog upsert. No override. |
| `misfire_strategy_code`<a id="column-acta-schedules--misfire-strategy-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`MisfireStrategyCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-misfirestrategycode) (`misfire-strategy`) | MisfireStrategy policy when occurrences are missed during downtime (catch-up once vs. skip). |
| `next_run_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-schedules--next-run-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | Canonical per-schedule cursor: the next instant this schedule is due. The slot Job's `next_run_at_utc` is MIN over its live schedules. NULL means the schedule is exhausted (no further occurrence). Computed in C# (`NextOccurrenceCalculator` / `ScheduleWalker`); the SQL appliers only persist it. |
| `last_occurrence_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-schedules--last-occurrence-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | The most recent schedule occurrence this row was advanced past, set to the outgoing `NextRunAtUtc` on every advance. Deliberately an occurrence, not a run: the cursor also moves when the misfire policy skips, so this records the latest schedule point *crossed* rather than a completed execution. NULL until the schedule first advances. Explains why `NextRunAtUtc` holds its current value, and is the only per-schedule history when several schedules share one recurring slot Job. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-schedules--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`ScheduleStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-schedulestatuscode) (`schedule-status`) | Lifecycle state and the single source of truth for orphaning. `Active` schedules fire; `Paused` schedules do not and are excluded from the slot's MIN; `Orphaned` is set by catalog reconciliation when the origin declaration disappears, and the walker ignores those rows (`ix_schedules_namespace_next` filters them out). Only `Definition`-origin rows can be orphaned, since no other origin has a descriptor anchor to be orphaned from. An orphaned row that is re-declared resets to `Active`: the pause does not survive, because a schedule that vanished and came back warrants a fresh operator decision. |
| `paused_until_utc`<a id="column-acta-schedules--paused-until-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | When a timed pause expires. NULL means an indefinite pause (resume is operator-driven) or not paused. While set, the slot's cursor includes this instant so the scheduler wakes to auto-resume: the walker flips the row back to `Active` and reconciles the cursor by misfire policy. |
| `description`<a id="column-acta-schedules--description"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Dev-authored explanation of the schedule from the [JobSchedule] attribute; NULL when the attribute sets none. Distinct from `ReasonMessage`, which is operator-written. |
| `reason_message`<a id="column-acta-schedules--reason-message"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Operator-authored justification for the last pause/resume/overrides change: the same reasonMessage text the audit event records, kept on the row so the current state explains itself. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-schedules--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the schedule row was created. Set server-side. |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-schedules--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | Last write of any kind. Drives the per-namespace reload tick. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-schedules--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token; SPs manually increment via `SET version = version + 1` on every UPDATE. |

**Indexes**

| Name | Columns | Uniqueness | Filter | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ix_schedules_namespace_next` | `namespace_id`, `next_run_at_utc`, `id` | not unique | `status_code <> 230` | `scheduler` |
| `ux_schedules_job_name` | `job_id`, `name` | unique | none | `uniqueness` |

**Check constraints**

| `ck_schedules_paused_pair` | `status_code = 30 OR paused_until_utc IS NULL` |
| `ck_schedules_orphan_origin` | `origin_code = 40 OR status_code <> 230` |

| Constraint | Column → Target | On delete |
|---|---|---|
| `fk_schedules_jobs` | `job_id` → `acta.jobs(id)` | CASCADE |
| `fk_schedules_definitions` | `definition_id` → `acta.definitions(id)` | NO ACTION |

### `acta.settings` <a id="entity-acta-settings"></a>

One durable configuration value in the central `settings` table, addressed by `(scope_code, scope_id, name)`. Holds slow-changing operator/deployment configuration only, never fast-changing runtime state (that lives on substrate tables). Not read on any hot path yet; consumers resolve a setting by scope and fall back (definition, then namespace, then global) at point of use. Boundary rules: a value an operator filters by is a tag; a value the engine reads per-claim or per-execution, or that must appear on the definition views, is a policy column (settings are forbidden on the hot path); a behavior knob read cold by name at a scope is a setting.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.Setting` · **Primary key** `pk_settings` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-settings--id"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Surrogate row identifier; DB-assigned identity. |
| `scope_code`<a id="column-acta-settings--scope-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`SettingScopeCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-settingscopecode) (`setting-scope`) | Scope discriminator (Global / Namespace / Definition). Part of the natural identity carried by the filtered unique pair `ux_settings_scope_name` / `ux_settings_global_name`. |
| `scope_id`<a id="column-acta-settings--scope-id"></a> | `Int32` | · | yes | · | · | Target catalog row for narrowed scopes (`namespaces.id` / `definitions.id`); NULL for `Global`. No FK: the referenced catalog differs per `ScopeCode`. |
| `name`<a id="column-acta-settings--name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Lowercase dotted-kebab setting name (for example `sys.claim.batch-size`). ASCII Acta name. |
| `value_format_id`<a id="column-acta-settings--value-format-id"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPayloadFormat`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobpayloadformat) | Format-id selector for `Value`; same payload-format convention as job input and variables. `ck_settings_value_pair` enforces `(value_format_id = 0) = (value IS NULL)`. |
| `value`<a id="column-acta-settings--value"></a> | `BinaryPayload` | max | yes | · | · | Encoded setting value; opaque bytes governed by `ValueFormatId`. |
| `description`<a id="column-acta-settings--description"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Operator-readable description of what the setting controls. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-settings--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the setting row was first inserted. Set server-side. |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-settings--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | Last-write instant. Rendered server-side on INSERT; operations bump it on UPDATE. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-settings--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token; operations manually increment via `SET version = version + 1` on every UPDATE. |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ux_settings_scope_name` | `scope_code`, `scope_id`, `name` | unique | `scope_id IS NOT NULL` | `uniqueness` |
| `ux_settings_global_name` | `scope_code`, `name` | unique | `scope_id IS NULL` | `uniqueness` |

**Check constraints**

### `acta.steps` <a id="entity-acta-steps"></a>

Substrate row carrying durable retry / result state for one step slot inside a Job. Written by the `start_step` / `complete_step` operations that back `ctx.RunStepAsync`. One row per `(JobId, Name)`; INSERT on first invocation (`State = Pending`), UPDATE-in-place across retries, terminal transition to `Succeeded` or `Exhausted`.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobStep` · **Primary key** `pk_steps` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-steps--id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Surrogate row identifier. |
| `job_id`<a id="column-acta-steps--job-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | · | · | Owning Job. CASCADE FK. Part of the natural identity carried by `ux_steps_job_name`. |
| `name`<a id="column-acta-steps--name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Step slot name. Kebab-case ASCII. Part of the natural identity carried by `ux_steps_job_name`. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-steps--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobStepStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobstepstatuscode) (`job-step-status`) | `Pending` while retrying; `Succeeded` / `Exhausted` on terminal. CHECK rejects 0. |
| `attempt_number`<a id="column-acta-steps--attempt-number"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Step attempt ordinal across retries (1-based; incremented on each failure within budget). |
| `next_retry_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-steps--next-retry-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | yes | · | · | When the next retry attempt is scheduled. NULL on terminal rows. |
| `reason_code`<a id="column-acta-steps--reason-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | yes | · | [`JobEventReasonCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobeventreasoncode) (`job-event-reason`) | Machine-readable reason of the most recent failed attempt. NULL until first failure; preserved on terminal `Exhausted` rows so post-mortem reads always have the final failure context. |
| `reason_message`<a id="column-acta-steps--reason-message"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Free-form prose paired with `ReasonCode`. NULL until first failure; truncated by `MessageTruncator`. |
| `result_format_id`<a id="column-acta-steps--result-format-id"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`JobPayloadFormat`](./code-families.md#code-family-jobpayloadformat) | Format-id selector for `Result`; `0` means no result (void step or in-flight or exhausted). `ck_steps_result_pair` enforces `(result_format_id = 0) = (result IS NULL)`. |
| `result`<a id="column-acta-steps--result"></a> | `BinaryPayload` | max | yes | · | · | Encoded step result; opaque bytes. NULL when `ResultFormatId` is 0. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-steps--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | First-invocation instant; the wall-clock anchor for the `complete_step``RetryWindow` predicate (`nextRetryAtUtc > CreatedAtUtc + RetryWindow` exhausts the step). Rendered server-side via `UtcNow` on the initial INSERT and never updated thereafter. |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-steps--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | Last-write instant. Advances on every `Status` transition or attempt update. |

### `acta.tags` <a id="entity-acta-tags"></a>

Exact searchable metadata attached to one target. A tag scope identifies the exact target to which searchable metadata is attached. Tag scopes do not inherit, fall back, propagate, or participate in precedence resolution.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.Tag` · **Primary key** `pk_tags` (`scope_code`, `scope_id`, `name`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope_code`<a id="column-acta-tags--scope-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`TagScopeCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-tagscopecode) (`tag-scope`) | Exact target type; independent of `SettingScopeCode`. |
| `scope_id`<a id="column-acta-tags--scope-id"></a> | `Int64` | · | no | · | PK | Target row id, with smaller target identifiers widened to bigint. |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-tags--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | yes | · | · | Owning namespace for reverse search. Tenant tags are null; namespace tags carry their own id; every other target carries its owning namespace. |
| `name`<a id="column-acta-tags--name"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | PK | Normalized dotted-kebab ASCII name. |
| `value`<a id="column-acta-tags--value"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Optional caller-preserved Unicode value; null represents a presence-only tag. |
| `value_search`<a id="column-acta-tags--value-search"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Length-checked case-folded exact-search projection generated in .NET. |

### `acta.tenants` <a id="entity-acta-tenants"></a>

Acta-owned catalog of tenants: the customer / business entity a Job is about. A tenant is an optional, validated scope on individual Jobs, orthogonal to `JobNamespace`, which remains the microservice / work-ownership boundary. Tenants do not own workers, namespaces, job definitions, schedules, or system Jobs; tenant is currently audit / query / runtime scope only, never a scheduling or claim scope. Rows are append-only (no hard delete); `Status` gates whether a key resolves at enqueue. The runtime upserts a row by `TenantKey` via the `RegisterTenant` handler and reads the assigned id back.

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.Tenant` · **Primary key** `pk_tenants` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-tenants--id"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | DB-assigned identity. Referenced by `job.tenant_id` and `events.tenant_id`. Callers never pick the value; the runtime upserts the row by `TenantKey` and reads the id back. |
| `tenant_key`<a id="column-acta-tenants--tenant-key"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Caller-supplied external tenant identifier (an opaque key such as a GUID, ULID, or customer code, not a human label). Unique. Validated as opaque (non-empty, no `"sys."` prefix, at most 128 chars) rather than kebab. Resolved to `Id` at enqueue; the human label lives in `DisplayName`. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-tenants--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`TenantStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-tenantstatuscode) (`tenant-status`) | Tenant lifecycle status. `Active` resolves at enqueue; `Suspended` rejects the enqueue (reversible). Supplied at INSERT by the `RegisterTenant` handler (no server-side default). |
| `display_name`<a id="column-acta-tenants--display-name"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Human display label for dashboards and pickers; NULL falls back to the key. |
| `description`<a id="column-acta-tenants--description"></a> | `UnicodeString` | 512 | yes | · | · | Longer operator-readable notes about the tenant. Unicode-capable. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-tenants--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the tenant row was first created. Set server-side. |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-tenants--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the tenant row was last updated. Set server-side on every mutation. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-tenants--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token; SPs manually increment on UPDATE. |

**Indexes**

| Name | Columns | Uniqueness | Filter | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ux_tenants_key` | `tenant_key` | unique | none | `uniqueness` |

### `acta.workers` <a id="entity-acta-workers"></a>

Worker registration and liveness row. One row per worker process; every `WorkerRuntime.InitializeAsync` call INSERTs a fresh row representing that runtime's lifetime, identified by the DB-assigned `Id`. A single host can produce many rows (multiple containers, multi-runtime processes, restarts), and rows are never reused. The retention sweep deletes terminal workers - `Stopped` and `Dead` alike - older than `JobsOptions.WorkerRetention` (default `P90D`).

**CLR type** `Acta.Relational.Entities.JobWorker` · **Primary key** `pk_workers` (`id`)

**Columns**

| Column | Kind | Size | Nullable | Default | Codes | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id`<a id="column-acta-workers--id"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `Identity` | PK | Worker process identifier; never reused. |
| `worker_ref`<a id="column-acta-workers--worker-ref"></a> | `Guid` | · | no | · | · | Public stable reference exposed to dashboards, HTTP APIs, and event projections in place of the numeric id; rendered externally as "wrk_" plus 26 lowercase Crockford Base32 characters. Allocated in C# (a UUIDv7 via `New`) and passed into the registering routine, never defaulted by the database. The events timeline stores this value as its worker actor key, so an event stays attributable after the retention sweep deletes the worker row. |
| `namespace_id`<a id="column-acta-workers--namespace-id"></a> | `Int16` | · | no | · | · | Namespace this worker claims within. Enforced by `fk_workers_namespaces`. |
| `status_code`<a id="column-acta-workers--status-code"></a> | `Byte` | · | no | · | [`WorkerStatusCode`](./code-families.md#code-family-workerstatuscode) (`worker-status`) | Worker lifecycle status, written by the `StartWorker` handler at startup. `sys.recovery` flips stale rows to `Dead` when `LastHeartbeatAtUtc` falls past `JobsOptions.WorkerDeadAfter`, alongside its stuck-job lease reclaim. |
| `deployment_version`<a id="column-acta-workers--deployment-version"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | no | · | · | Opaque deployment version (git SHA, build number) for triage. |
| `host`<a id="column-acta-workers--host"></a> | `AsciiString` | 256 | no | · | · | Hostname or pod name; informational. |
| `engine_version`<a id="column-acta-workers--engine-version"></a> | `AsciiString` | 128 | yes | · | · | Acta engine assembly informational version, distinct from `DeploymentVersion` (the host app's version). Stamped once at registration. NULL when the Acta engine informational version could not be resolved at registration. |
| `dotnet_version`<a id="column-acta-workers--dotnet-version"></a> | `AsciiString` | 64 | yes | · | · | Runtime framework description, e.g. ".NET 10.0.0" (`RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription`). NULL when `RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription` was unavailable at registration. |
| `process_id`<a id="column-acta-workers--process-id"></a> | `Int32` | · | yes | · | · | OS process id of the worker process (`Environment.ProcessId`); informational. NULL when the OS process id was not captured / unavailable. |
| `max_concurrency`<a id="column-acta-workers--max-concurrency"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | · | · | Effective per-process executor cap (`JobsOptions.MaxConcurrentExecutors`) recorded at registration. |
| `last_seen_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-workers--last-seen-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | · | · | Liveness heartbeat. Written on startup by `StartWorker` and refreshed every `JobsOptions.HeartbeatInterval` by `WorkerHeartbeat` while the worker runs. |
| `created_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-workers--created-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | Process start time. |
| `modified_at_utc`<a id="column-acta-workers--modified-at-utc"></a> | `UtcInstant` | · | no | `UtcNow` | · | When the worker row was last updated. Set server-side on every mutation. |
| `version`<a id="column-acta-workers--version"></a> | `Int32` | · | no | `0` | concurrency token | Optimistic-concurrency token; SPs manually increment on UPDATE. |

**Indexes**

| Name | Columns | Uniqueness | Filter | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ix_workers_namespace_status_last_seen` | `namespace_id`, `status_code`, `last_seen_at_utc` | not unique | none | `dashboard` |
| `ix_workers_status_last_seen` | `status_code`, `last_seen_at_utc` | not unique | none | `maintenance` |

| `ux_workers_ref` | `worker_ref` | unique | none | `uniqueness` |

| Name | SQL expression |
|---|---|
